def load_unverified_project_from_config(project_root: Path
    ) ->UnverifiedProjectModel:
    config_path = project_root / PROJECT_CONFIG
    
    if not config_path.exists():
        return UnverifiedProjectModel()
    
    config = configparser.ConfigParser()
    config.read(config_path)
    
    project_data = {}
    
    if PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION in config.sections():
        if PROJECT_CONFIG_ID in config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION]:
            project_data['id'] = config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION][PROJECT_CONFIG_ID]
        if PROJECT_CONFIG_URL in config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION]:
            project_data['url_path'] = config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION][PROJECT_CONFIG_URL]
        if PROJECT_CONFIG_NAME in config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION]:
            project_data['name'] = config[PROJECT_CONFIG_SECTION][PROJECT_CONFIG_NAME]
    
    return UnverifiedProjectModel(**project_data)
